Product Id: Changes have been made to the content and methodology of the Natural Gas Supply and Disposition table. These new changes have resulted in the creation of table 25-10-0086 by amalgamating 25-10-0057, 25-10-0058, 25-10-0059 and 25-10-0055 alongside the addition of other key variables. The historical tables will remain available but will not be updated for historical revisions as the full series will be maintained with table 25-10-0086.

Total marketable gas production includes gas received from fields and processing or reprocessing plants after deducting volumes from re-injection, field uses, processing and reprocessing plant shrinkage, plant use and losses.
Imports include all natural gas and liquefied natural gas (LNG) entering Canada from another country. It may include natural gas exported previously from Canada (ex-transit shipment).

Industrial consumption includes all natural gas delivered by pipeline systems to industrial consumers. It excludes natural gas consumed in the natural gas extraction process. It may also exclude associated gas consumed in the extraction of oil and oilsands.

Exports include all natural gas and liquefied natural gas (LNG) exiting Canadian territory for another country. It may include natural gas previously imported from the United States (in-transit shipment).
Totals may not equal the sum of their parts due to the use of conversion factors or rounding of fractions to whole numbers.
Receipts from and deliveries to other provinces are inter-regional transfers only and do not show the province of origin. These variables have been derived.

Customer count data were not collected from January 2016 to December 2018, therefore the methodology used in publishing these data differ from the collected data published from January 2019 forward. Data is subject to revision.
